method: Current official patriarchal, diocesan, monastery, parish, and mission sources were checked for Andorra, Monaco, San Marino, and Vatican City. Search and map results were used only for discovery and were not accepted as proof of canonical parentage or current worship.

historical_or_reconciled.name: Orthodox community founded in Monaco in 2018
historical_or_reconciled.status: historical predecessor, not a separate current row
historical_or_reconciled.reason: The official 2018 diocesan account records a newly formed Monaco community under Archpriest Vadim Zakrevski. The Holy Synod placed the Parish of the Holy Royal Passion-Bearers in the Diocese of Korsun in 2020, and the same rector serves that current parish in the official 2026 diocesan account. The current parish is published once under the Diocese of Korsun.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The Monaco Chapel of the All-Holy Mother of God and the San Marino Parish of Saint Michael the Archangel are included. The Metropolis of Spain and Portugal officially includes Andorra in its territory, but no separate current Andorra body or recurring worship site was documented by its official material. No Vatican City body was found.
No body or recurring worship site in the four microstates appears in the official territorial structure.
No body or recurring worship site in the four microstates was found in the official European structure checked.
No body or recurring worship site in the four microstates appears in the official administrative structure.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Russian Orthodox Church, direct Moscow structures
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current Kazan Icon community in Andorra and the Holy Royal Passion-Bearers parish in Monaco are included. Official structures assign San Marino to the Moscow parishes in Italy, but no separate current San Marino body or recurring worship site was found. No Vatican City body was found.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The Parish of the Holy Equal-to-the-Apostles Empress Elena in Monaco is included. The current official directory contains no Andorra, San Marino, or Vatican City body.

The Parish of the Holy Great Martyr Marina in San Marino is included. The current France and Andorra list contains no Andorra body and identifies Menton as a filial worship site in France, not Monaco. No Vatican City body was found.

The official diocese assigns San Marino to an Italian, San Marino, and Malta archpriest district, but its current temple directory documents no separate worship body or recurring worship site in San Marino. No body was found in Andorra, Monaco, or Vatican City.
